programs.title: Unsellable Houses
programs.desc: Lyndsay and Leslie return to their hometown of Mukilteo to help a retired Navy commander and his wife update their home; with a sunken living room, a cramped kitchen and a vanity sink in the middle of the main bedroom, the twins face big obstacles.

programs.title: Unsellable Houses
programs.desc: Two sisters are tasked with selling their parents' previous home and look to increase its value with some updates; Lyndsay and Leslie mentor twins Bryce and Colby in the ways of twinning.

programs.title: Life Is Messy
programs.desc: Matt and Sam are at their wit's end. The daily grind of raising two young kids while juggling careers and Matt's busy marathon schedule has worn them down. They have no time to keep their home organized and clutter has consumed their lives, taking a toll on their relationship. Kortney and Kenny help them through the emotional journey of letting go, so they can get their home organized, functional, and a place to love again.

programs.title: The Block Australia
programs.desc: Teams compete to see who can renovate houses on Phillip Island for the most profit, as the properties are placed on auction soon after refurbishments are completed.

programs.title: Sun, Sea and Selling Houses
programs.desc: Two British families set up shop in Spain to sell property to Britain families looking for a bit of fun in the sun.

programs.title: House Hunters International
programs.desc: After falling in love with the city while she was in college, a young woman looks to return to earn her master's degree in Madrid; a fellow ex-pat is along to help find her first solo place ever, but scoring a home on a student budget may be a challenge.
